messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for route /v1/generate (eu-west). current p99 = 1980ms (SLO 1500ms). Rolling 5m window. PagerDuty incident PD-45219 fired.

pagerduty-bot: PD-45219 triggered by alerting-rule: latency-p99-euw > 1500ms. Auto-page to eng-oncall.

Maria G: acked PD-45219 — taking lead. I'm joining. Has anyone confirmed if it's widespread or just a subset of models/hosts?

Samir Patel: I see spike across multiple model backends in eu-west, not just one instance. Grafana shows one big cluster of 3xx requests with long token gen time.

Alex L: adding context: traffic spiky since 10:02 UTC (root cause unknown). No deploys in the last 30m per deploy-bot.

Lee (SRE): quick checks: kernel CPU steady, mem ok, GPU util around 92% on several nodes. Might be KV cache thrash or overloaded autoscaler. Running `curl` on one sidecar to capture tail logs.

Samir Patel: stack traces show recurrent "KVCache miss" and backend retrying. snippet: ```2026-03-15T10:08:21Z WARN kvcache: miss key=conv-xxx rate=0.12 retries=2```

Maria G: customer impact? any errors returned to clients or just latency?

Samir Patel: mostly latency; a few 504s when retry budget exhausted (~0.4% of requests). Checking error budget routed to premium customers.

Lee (SRE): mitigation idea: temporarily route traffic from eu-west heavy tenants to fallback model variant with lower memory pressure. We can also enable aggressive prefix caching on next deploy but that's slower.

Alex L: can we scale up Dedicated pool temporarily? autoscaler is at max for that pool due to quota. We can spin up small burst capacity in us-west and use smart routing as emergency. Need approvals from infra.

Maria G: Samir, can you run KV cache diagnostics and evict hot keys gently? Use the thundering-herd-safe evict command.

Samir Patel: running safe eviction now: `./ops/kv-ctl evict --pattern hotkey* --grace=30s --rate-limit=120/s`

incident-bot: Action recorded: user Samir Patel invoked kv-ctl evict on cluster eu-west; job id evict-179111-01.

Lee (SRE): eviction started. Watching p95/p99. If this doesn't help in 3m we'll flip route fallback.

Maria G: tagging product: high-traffic tenants might notice degraded latency. Escalating to customer success if 504s keep rising.

Samir Patel: eviction reduced miss rate by ~35% so far. p99 fell to ~1650ms. Still above SLO but trending down.

Alex L: good. I'm prepping a regional routing change: move non-privacy tenants to us-west fallback. Need a +1 from infra for cross-region route.

Lee (SRE): +1 from me, but confirm rate limits and tokenization latency differences. Also update the routing policy to respect customer pinning.

Maria G: PagerDuty update: PD-45219 status -> acknowledged. We're in mitigation. I'll keep CS in the loop.

Sanjay (oncall): I'll take the next 30m monitoring window and handle handoff once stable. Maria, want to do a quick verbal Handoff at 10:30 UTC?

Maria G: yes, will do. Current plan: 1) safe evict hot keys (done), 2) monitor; if p99 stays >1600ms after 5m, initiate regional reroute for non-pinned traffic, 3) if 504s >1%, open customer impact alert and engage CS.

Samir Patel: metrics now p99 1420ms. Looks back under SLO. I'll keep the eviction guard running for 15m.

Alex L: rolling back the routing plan for now — won't proceed since p99 recovered. We'll keep the plan as a playbook.

Maria G: thanks team. PD-45219 -> status: Resolved (mitigated). Leaving a note for postmortem. Please add relevant logs and runbook updates.

Lee (SRE): filing runbook tweak: add automatic backoff-evict when kv miss rate spikes >10% for 2m. assigning to Samir.

Samir Patel: noted, will add PR with tests.

incident-bot: PD-45219 closed by Maria G at 10:20 UTC.

Alex L: postmortem checklist: - collect req traces for 10:00-10:15 - confirm no config drift - quantify customer impact (IDs + %CPU windows) - propose longer-term fix (kv hotkey sharding + circuit-breaker).

Maria G: I'll draft an incident summary and assign action items. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:

Lee (SRE): reaction :thumbsup:. Handoff to Sanjay for continued watch.

Sanjay (oncall): taking watch. Will escalate if recurrence.

Maria G: thread closed — follow-up items in #postmortems.
